raw_html: [[Utter Disintegration Guard|Utter Disintegration Guard]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Utter Disintegration Guard]]:''' This item has a dark, insidious power deep within. Occasionally, this power lashes out violently at enemies that strike you and attempts to disintegrate them. This disintegrate is incredibly powerful, and will utterly destroy weaker foes.
